Baseline maintenance: this story removes censused mechanism(s) `REBAR_RECONCILER_CREATE_ROUTE`, `REBAR_RECONCILER_WRITE_FACADE`, `REBAR_RECONCILER_FAIL_SILENT_NOOP` (the three `env_var` rows). Because `tests/unit/test_mechanism_delta.py:357-364` asserts the committed baseline equals the live tree, run `python scripts/check_mechanism_delta.py --update-stale` in the same change and commit `.github/mechanism-baseline.json` (operator-sanctioned on the epic; precedent commit 81da792). State the sanction in the commit message.

Also deleted in this story and possibly censused: any autouse fixture inside `tests/unit/reconciler/mutate/test_apply_outbound_create_rollback.py` (`_force_legacy_route`) — the same `--update-stale` run drains it.

## Context / Problem
Three finished rollouts still keep their switches in production code. `REBAR_RECONCILER_CREATE_ROUTE` (`create_route.py:77-93`; legacy create path `apply_outbound.py:102-145`, `dispatch_one.py:363-415`, `batch_dispatch.py:251,264-269`, `apply_handlers.py:197-198`). `REBAR_RECONCILER_WRITE_FACADE` (`reconcile_helpers.py:245-256,295-296`): landed by epic RP-04 `vibrant-legal-hind` (closed) S3 as the AC6 rollback switch; its S7 `junior-lepidolite-boa` (closed) checked "legacy facades/switches removed", and `disturbed-antiutopic-pullet` is that epic's `session_log` and needs nothing — deleting the switch completes S7. `REBAR_RECONCILER_FAIL_SILENT_NOOP` (readers `apply_handlers.py:282,551,589`) is set to `"1"` in the sole live deployment, `.github/workflows/reconcile-bridge.yml:287`. Decision: promote fail-loud to unconditional and delete all three env vars (no test hook, no injected parameter). Cites are on origin/main 083620b0 (engine paths are under `src/rebar/reconciler/` after the package move).

## Approach
1. Delete `create_route()`, `LEGACY_ROUTE`, `_LEGACY_TOKENS`, `_COORDINATOR_TOKENS`; `route_for` (`batch_dispatch.py:254-281`) returns `COORDINATOR_ROUTE` for create unconditionally; delete `_apply_outbound_create_legacy`, `_legacy_create_core`, `_legacy_record_key`, the `create_core` fallback default at `dispatch_one.py:213` (`create_core` becomes required), and the `apply_handlers.py:197-198` branch.
2. Delete `_write_facade_enabled` and its `if not …: return` guard; `bind_operation_runtime` always composes. Delete the `applier._load_acli` ambient fallback at `applier.py:389-390,545` and the `applier._load_acli` test seam that `_resolve_pass_transport` honours: `apply()` requires `client` (raise `TypeError` when `None` and any mutation exists). `fetcher._load_acli` (`:113`) stays (fetch composes its own transport).
3. Make the three fail-loud branches unconditional; delete the env reads and `reconcile-bridge.yml:287`; update `docs/config.md:395-403`, regenerate `docs/env-vars.md`, update `docs/user-guide.md`, add the `CHANGELOG.md` BREAKING entry.
4. Baseline: the three `env_var` rows in `.github/mechanism-baseline.json` become stale; because `tests/unit/test_mechanism_delta.py:357-364` asserts the committed baseline equals the live tree, run `python scripts/check_mechanism_delta.py --update-stale` in the same change and commit the baseline (operator-sanctioned on the epic, stated in the commit message; itemised in this ticket's comments).
5. Tests: delete `tests/unit/reconciler/mutate/test_apply_outbound_create_rollback.py` (`_force_legacy_route` fixture); rewrite `test_silent_noop_canary.py:160-177`, `test_fail_loud_comment_errors.py:146,180`, `tests/scripts/test_reconciler_core_seam_clean_heldout.py:226-233` to assert unconditional hard-fail; update the `test_live_mode_failure_tally.py` docstring.

BREAKING: env vars `REBAR_RECONCILER_CREATE_ROUTE`, `REBAR_RECONCILER_WRITE_FACADE`, `REBAR_RECONCILER_FAIL_SILENT_NOOP` removed; silent sub-op no-ops and swallowed comment failures always fail the mutation.

## Scope
`src/rebar/reconciler/{create_route,apply_outbound,dispatch_one,batch_dispatch,apply_handlers,reconcile_helpers,applier,reconcile}.py`, `.github/workflows/reconcile-bridge.yml`, `.github/mechanism-baseline.json`, `docs/config.md`, `docs/env-vars.md`, `docs/user-guide.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`, the tests named above. Out of scope: `fetcher._load_acli`, `MODE_CAPS` and the bootstrap modes (live consumers, kept), and every other `REBAR_RECONCILER_*` variable.

## Testing
Happy: `pytest tests/unit/reconciler/mutate tests/unit/reconciler/apply -q`. Edge: `REBAR_RECONCILER_CREATE_ROUTE=legacy pytest tests/unit/reconciler/mutate/test_create_live_cutover_heldout.py` behaves identically (env ignored); a `comment_errors`-carrying outcome with no env set has `outcome["error"]` starting `comment-errors:`; `applier.apply(mutations, pass_id, root, client=None)` with a non-empty list raises `TypeError`; `python scripts/gen_env_registry.py --check` clean; `python scripts/check_mechanism_delta.py --check` prints `new=0`; `git grep -n 'REBAR_RECONCILER_\(CREATE_ROUTE\|WRITE_FACADE\|FAIL_SILENT_NOOP\)' -- src docs .github` returns only `CHANGELOG.md` and `docs/release-notes.md` hits.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] The three env names appear nowhere in `src/`, `.github/workflows/`, `docs/` except `CHANGELOG.md` and `docs/release-notes.md` — grep.
- [ ] `route_for("create")` is `"coordinator"` with no env influence — unit test.
- [ ] Silent-no-op and swallowed comment failures count toward `mutation_failures` unconditionally — canary tests.
- [ ] `python scripts/check_mechanism_delta.py --check` prints `new=0` against the committed baseline — `make lint`.
- [ ] `make verify` exits 0.
